data.name: Her Name Was April
data.detailed_description:
Join April on this adventure and conquer the mountain together. But be careful, because this mountain plays with the mind!

Her Name Was April

You play a woman trying to find herself. Someone who felt compelled to embark on this journey, unaware of what she will encounter. Can you complete this journey despite what lies at the summit of that mountain?

Mysterious and Visually Impressive

I paid special attention to making the mountain stylish and impressive. Are you ready to see the view from the summit?

4-6 Hours of Gameplay

This impressive world consists of 12 side chapters and 4 main chapters. There are also a few bonus chapters!

Everyone Can Play!

Her Name Was April includes a support mode so everyone can play.

data.short_description: Her Name Was April is a 3D platform game developed by a single developer. It aims to stand out with its story and visuals, while also not being overly difficult.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070, 8GB or AMD Radeon RX 5600, 6GB or Intel Arc B570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: No
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K or AMD Ryzen 7 5700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti, 11GB or AMD Radeon VII, 16GB or Intel Arc B580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: No

content_descriptors.notes: Although Her Name Was April does not contain any scenes of self-harm, it does have distinct depictions of it.
